MITIGATING MEASURES DURING MINING OPERATIONS
Air Quality
A program of regular watering of the access and haul roads will minimize airborne dust arising from unpaved surfaces. Prompt revegetation of reclaimed and other disturbed areas will help alleviate potential problems from blowing dust. The loading facilities are constructed with covered conveyors and most coal transfer points are enclosed to minimize dust.
The fugitive dust will not exceed the Federal standards published and enforced by the Environmental Protection Agency. Workers will be required to wear goggles and respirators, in accordance with Federal Coal Mine Health, and Safety Act of 1969, to alleviate adverse effects of dust, although it should be recognized that compliance by the workers is often sporadic.
Sound
Noise levels are periodically measured in areas involved with coal production activities. Also, high noise areas are posted with appropriate warnings. Dispersal of noise created by heavy equipment utilized in coal production is rapid. However, mufflers on exhaust systems are mandatory.
